system.story: Understand people before you move them - the social counterpart to a Scout's Mark.

effect.after:
Maneuver (in or out of combat), no Influence. Make an Insight or Presence read on a target: learn a Motivation, a Pitfall, an attitude, or a tell. Feeds the Negotiation legwork directly.

Enhance (spend 1 Influence): read multiple targets at once, or gain an argument edge against the target for the rest of the scene.

Influence loop: a successful Insight read (a called tell, a spotted lie) grants a small Influence bonus - the class is rewarded for reading people.
